question: Which user has a higher reputation, Harlan or Jarrod Dixon?
golden_sql: SELECT DisplayName FROM users WHERE DisplayName IN ('Harlan', 'Jarrod Dixon') AND Reputation = (SELECT MAX(Reputation) FROM users WHERE DisplayName IN ('Harlan', 'Jarrod Dixon'))

question: Please list the display names of all the users whose accounts were created in the year 2011.
golden_sql: SELECT DisplayName FROM users WHERE TO_CHAR(CAST(CreationDate AS TIMESTAMP), 'YYYY') = '2011'

question: How many users last accessed the website after 2014/9/1?
golden_sql: SELECT COUNT(Id) FROM users WHERE DATE(LastAccessDate) > '2014-09-01'

question: Who is the owner of the post "Eliciting priors from experts"?
golden_sql: SELECT T2.DisplayName FROM posts AS T1 INNER JOIN users AS T2 ON T1.OwnerUserId = T2.Id WHERE T1.Title = 'Eliciting priors from experts'

question: How many posts does the user csgillespie own?
golden_sql: SELECT COUNT(T1.id) FROM posts AS T1 INNER JOIN users AS T2 ON T1.OwnerUserId = T2.Id WHERE T2.DisplayName = 'csgillespie'

question: What is the display name of the user who last edited the post "Examples for teaching: Correlation does not mean causation"?
golden_sql: SELECT T2.DisplayName FROM posts AS T1 INNER JOIN users AS T2 ON T1.LastEditorUserId = T2.Id WHERE T1.Title = 'Examples for teaching: Correlation does not mean causation'

question: Among the posts owned by an elder user, how many of them have a score of over 19?
golden_sql: SELECT COUNT(T1.Id) FROM posts AS T1 INNER JOIN users AS T2 ON T1.OwnerUserId = T2.Id WHERE T1.Score >= 20 AND T2.Age > 65

question: From which post is the tag "bayesian" excerpted from? Please give the body of the post.
golden_sql: SELECT T2.Body FROM tags AS T1 INNER JOIN posts AS T2 ON T2.Id = T1.ExcerptPostId WHERE T1.TagName = 'bayesian'

question: What is the average score of the posts owned by the user csgillespie?
golden_sql: SELECT AVG(T1.Score) FROM posts AS T1 INNER JOIN users AS T2 ON T1.OwnerUserId = T2.Id WHERE T2.DisplayName = 'csgillespie'

question: Among the posts with a score of over 5, what is the percentage of them being owned by an elder user?
golden_sql: SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN T2.Age > 65 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / NULLIF(COUNT(T1.Id), 0) FROM posts AS T1 INNER JOIN users AS T2 ON T1.OwnerUserId = T2.Id WHERE T1.Score > 5

question: User No.3025 gave a comment at 20:29:39 on 2014/4/23 to a post, how many favorite counts did that post get?
golden_sql: SELECT T1.FavoriteCount FROM posts AS T1 INNER JOIN comments AS T2 ON T1.Id = T2.PostId WHERE T2.CreationDate = '2014-04-23 20:29:39.0' AND T2.UserId = 3025

question: User No.23853 gave a comment to a post at 9:08:18 on 2013/7/12, was that post well-finished?
golden_sql: SELECT CASE WHEN T2.ClosedDate IS NULL THEN 'NOT well-finished' ELSE 'well-finished' END AS resylt FROM comments AS T1 INNER JOIN posts AS T2 ON T1.PostId = T2.Id WHERE T1.UserId = 23853 AND T1.CreationDate = '2013-07-12 09:08:18.0'

question: For the user with the display name of "Tiago Pasqualini", how many posts did he/she own?
golden_sql: SELECT COUNT(T1.Id) FROM users AS T1 INNER JOIN posts AS T2 ON T1.Id = T2.OwnerUserId WHERE T1.DisplayName = 'Tiago Pasqualini'

question: Provide the display name of the user who made the vote No.6347.
golden_sql: SELECT T1.DisplayName FROM users AS T1 INNER JOIN votes AS T2 ON T1.Id = T2.UserId WHERE T2.Id = 6347

question: For the user No.24, how many times is the number of his/her posts compared to his/her votes?
golden_sql: SELECT CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT T2.Id) AS REAL) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT T1.Id), 0) FROM votes AS T1 INNER JOIN posts AS T2 ON T1.UserId = T2.OwnerUserId WHERE T1.UserId = 24

question: How many views did the post titled 'Integration of Weka and/or RapidMiner into Informatica PowerCenter/Developer' get?
golden_sql: SELECT ViewCount FROM posts WHERE Title = 'Integration of Weka and/or RapidMiner into Informatica PowerCenter/Developer'

question: Write the contents of comments with a score of 17.
golden_sql: SELECT Text FROM comments WHERE Score = 17

question: Name the user that commented 'thank you user93!'
golden_sql: SELECT T1.DisplayName FROM users AS T1 INNER JOIN comments AS T2 ON T1.Id = T2.UserId WHERE T2.Text = 'thank you user93!'

question: Which user made a post titled 'Understanding what Dassault iSight is doing?' and how much is the reputation of the user?
golden_sql: SELECT T1.DisplayName, T1.Reputation FROM users AS T1 INNER JOIN posts AS T2 ON T1.Id = T2.OwnerUserId WHERE T2.Title = 'Understanding what Dassault iSight is doing?'

question: Who is the owner of the post titled 'Open source tools for visualizing multi-dimensional data?'
golden_sql: SELECT T2.DisplayName FROM posts AS T1 INNER JOIN users AS T2 ON T1.OwnerUserId = T2.Id WHERE T1.Title = 'Open source tools for visualizing multi-dimensional data?'

question: Write all the comments left by users who edited the post titled 'Why square the difference instead of taking the absolute value in standard deviation?'
golden_sql: SELECT T2.Comment FROM posts AS T1 INNER JOIN postHistory AS T2 ON T1.Id = T2.PostId WHERE T1.Title = 'Why square the difference instead of taking the absolute value in standard deviation?'

question: Which user added a bounty amount of 50 to the post title mentioning variance?
golden_sql: SELECT T3.DisplayName, T1.Title FROM posts AS T1 INNER JOIN votes AS T2 ON T1.Id = T2.PostId INNER JOIN users AS T3 ON T3.Id = T2.UserId WHERE T2.BountyAmount = 50 AND T1.Title LIKE '%variance%'

question: Calculate the average view count of each post tagged as 'humor' and list the title and the comment of each post.
golden_sql: SELECT AVG(T2.ViewCount) AS AverageViewCount, T2.Title, T1.Text FROM comments AS T1 INNER JOIN posts AS T2 ON T2.Id = T1.PostId WHERE T2.Tags = '<humor>' GROUP BY T2.Title, T1.Text

question: How many users are awarded with more than 5 badges?
golden_sql: SELECT COUNT(UserId) FROM (SELECT UserId, COUNT(Name) AS num FROM badges GROUP BY UserId) AS T WHERE T.num > 5

question: Which user have only one post history per post and having at least 1000 views?
golden_sql: SELECT T2.UserId FROM users AS T1 INNER JOIN postHistory AS T2 ON T1.Id = T2.UserId INNER JOIN posts AS T3 ON T2.PostId = T3.Id WHERE T3.ViewCount >= 1000 GROUP BY T2.UserId HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT T2.PostHistoryTypeId) = 1

question: What is the percentage difference of student badges given during 2010 and 2011?
golden_sql: SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN TO_CHAR(CAST(Date AS TIMESTAMP), 'YYYY') = '2010' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / NULLIF(COUNT(Id), 0) - CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN TO_CHAR(CAST(Date AS TIMESTAMP), 'YYYY') = '2011' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / NULLIF(COUNT(Id), 0) FROM badges WHERE Name = 'Student'

question: What is the average of the up votes and the average user age for users creating more than 10 posts?
golden_sql: SELECT AVG(T1.UpVotes), AVG(T1.Age) FROM users AS T1 INNER JOIN (SELECT OwnerUserId, COUNT(*) AS post_count FROM posts GROUP BY OwnerUserId HAVING COUNT(*) > 10) AS T2 ON T1.Id = T2.OwnerUserId

question: Calculate the ratio of votes in 2010 and 2011.
golden_sql: SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN TO_CHAR(CAST(CreationDate AS TIMESTAMP), 'YYYY') = '2010' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN TO_CHAR(CAST(CreationDate AS TIMESTAMP), 'YYYY') = '2011' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) FROM votes

question: Which post by slashnick has the most answers count? State the post ID.
golden_sql: SELECT T2.PostId FROM users AS T1 INNER JOIN postHistory AS T2 ON T1.Id = T2.UserId INNER JOIN posts AS T3 ON T2.PostId = T3.Id WHERE T1.DisplayName = 'slashnick' ORDER BY T3.AnswerCount DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 1

question: Among posts by Harvey Motulsky and Noah Snyder, which one has higher popularity?
golden_sql: SELECT T1.DisplayName FROM users AS T1 INNER JOIN postHistory AS T2 ON T1.Id = T2.UserId INNER JOIN posts AS T3 ON T2.PostId = T3.Id WHERE T1.DisplayName = 'Harvey Motulsky' OR T1.DisplayName = 'Noah Snyder' GROUP BY T1.DisplayName ORDER BY SUM(T3.ViewCount) DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 1

question: State all the tags used by Mark Meckes in his posts that doesn't have comments.
golden_sql: SELECT T3.Tags FROM users AS T1 INNER JOIN postHistory AS T2 ON T1.Id = T2.UserId INNER JOIN posts AS T3 ON T3.Id = T2.PostId WHERE T1.DisplayName = 'Mark Meckes' AND T3.CommentCount = 0

question: Based on posts posted by Community, calculate the percentage of posts that use the R language.
golden_sql: SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN T3.TagName = 'r' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / NULLIF(COUNT(T1.Id), 0) FROM users AS T1 INNER JOIN postHistory AS T2 ON T1.Id = T2.UserId INNER JOIN tags AS T3 ON T3.ExcerptPostId = T2.PostId WHERE T1.DisplayName = 'Community'

question: Calculate the difference in view count from post posted by Mornington and view count from posts posted by Amos.
golden_sql: SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN T1.DisplayName = 'Mornington' THEN T3.ViewCount ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN T1.DisplayName = 'Amos' THEN T3.ViewCount ELSE 0 END) AS diff FROM users AS T1 INNER JOIN postHistory AS T2 ON T1.Id = T2.UserId INNER JOIN posts AS T3 ON T3.Id = T2.PostId

question: What is the average monthly number of links created in 2010 for posts that have no more than 2 answers?
golden_sql: SELECT CAST(COUNT(T1.Id) AS REAL) / NULLIF(12, 0) FROM postLinks AS T1 INNER JOIN posts AS T2 ON T1.PostId = T2.Id WHERE T2.AnswerCount <= 2 AND TO_CHAR(CAST(T1.CreationDate AS TIMESTAMP), 'YYYY') = '2010'

question: When did 'chl' cast its first vote in a post?
golden_sql: SELECT T2.CreationDate FROM users AS T1 INNER JOIN votes AS T2 ON T1.Id = T2.UserId WHERE T1.DisplayName = 'chl' ORDER BY T2.CreationDate NULLS FIRST LIMIT 1

question: What is the display name of the user who acquired the first Autobiographer badge?
golden_sql: SELECT T1.DisplayName FROM users AS T1 INNER JOIN badges AS T2 ON T1.Id = T2.UserId WHERE T2.name = 'Autobiographer' ORDER BY T2.Date LIMIT 1

question: Among the users located in United Kingdom, how many users whose post have a total favorite amount of 4 or more?
golden_sql: SELECT COUNT(T1.Id) FROM users AS T1 INNER JOIN posts AS T2 ON T1.Id = T2.OwnerUserId WHERE T1.Location = 'United Kingdom' AND T2.FavoriteCount >= 4

question: Which post by Harvey Motulsky has the most views? Please give the id and title of this post.
golden_sql: SELECT T2.Id, T2.Title FROM users AS T1 INNER JOIN posts AS T2 ON T1.Id = T2.OwnerUserId WHERE T1.DisplayName = 'Harvey Motulsky' ORDER BY T2.ViewCount DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 1

question: Which is the most valuable post in 2010? Please give its id and the owner's display name.
golden_sql: SELECT T2.OwnerUserId, T1.DisplayName FROM users AS T1 INNER JOIN posts AS T2 ON T1.Id = T2.OwnerUserId WHERE TO_CHAR(CAST(T1.CreationDate AS TIMESTAMP), 'YYYY') = '2010' ORDER BY T2.FavoriteCount DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 1

question: What is the percentage of posts whose owners had a reputation of over 1000 in 2011?
golden_sql: SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN TO_CHAR(CAST(T2.CreaionDate AS TIMESTAMP), 'YYYY') = '2011' AND T1.Reputation > 1000 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / NULLIF(COUNT(T1.Id), 0) FROM users AS T1 INNER JOIN posts AS T2 ON T1.Id = T2.OwnerUserId

question: Identify the total views on the post 'Computer Game Datasets'. Name the user who posted it last time.
golden_sql: SELECT T2.ViewCount, T3.DisplayName FROM postHistory AS T1 INNER JOIN posts AS T2 ON T1.PostId = T2.Id INNER JOIN users AS T3 ON T2.LastEditorUserId = T3.Id WHERE T1.Text = 'Computer Game Datasets'

question: Provide the text of the latest 10 comments to the post with the title 'Analysing wind data with R' and the display name of the user who left it.
golden_sql: SELECT T3.Text, T1.DisplayName FROM users AS T1 INNER JOIN posts AS T2 ON T1.Id = T2.OwnerUserId INNER JOIN comments AS T3 ON T2.Id = T3.PostId WHERE T2.Title = 'Analysing wind data with R' ORDER BY T1.CreationDate DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10

question: Among all the posts posted by the most influential user, identify the percentage with a score above 50.
golden_sql: SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN T2.Score > 50 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / NULLIF(COUNT(T1.Id), 0) FROM users AS T1 INNER JOIN posts AS T2 ON T1.Id = T2.OwnerUserId INNER JOIN (SELECT MAX(Reputation) AS max_reputation FROM users) AS T3 ON T1.Reputation = T3.max_reputation

question: What is the excerpt post ID and wiki post ID of the tag named sample?
golden_sql: SELECT ExcerptPostId, WikiPostId FROM tags WHERE TagName = 'sample'

question: Give the user's reputation and up vote number of the user that commented "fine, you win :)".
golden_sql: SELECT T2.Reputation, T2.UpVotes FROM comments AS T1 INNER JOIN users AS T2 ON T1.UserId = T2.Id WHERE T1.Text = 'fine, you win :)'

question: Among the posts with views ranging from 100 to 150, what is the comment with the highest score?
golden_sql: SELECT Text FROM comments WHERE PostId IN (SELECT Id FROM posts WHERE ViewCount BETWEEN 100 AND 150) ORDER BY Score DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 1

question: In posts with 1 comment, how many of the comments have 0 score?
golden_sql: SELECT COUNT(T1.id) FROM comments AS T1 INNER JOIN posts AS T2 ON T1.PostId = T2.Id WHERE T2.CommentCount = 1 AND T2.Score = 0

question: Among the comments with scores between 5 to 10, what is the percentage of the users with 0 up votes?
golden_sql: SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN T1.UpVotes = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / NULLIF(COUNT(T1.Id), 0) AS per FROM users AS T1 INNER JOIN comments AS T2 ON T1.Id = T2.UserId WHERE T2.Score BETWEEN 5 AND 10
